{{Alliance}} [[Ariden's Camp]] | affiliation = [[Kirin Tor]], [[Stormwind (kingdom)|Kingdom of Stormwind]] (claimed), [[Deadwind ogres]] | loc = Central [[Azeroth (continent)|Azeroth]] }} '''Deadwind Pass''' is a contested zone located in central [[Azeroth (continent)|Azeroth]], joining the southeastern reaches of the [[Stormwind (kingdom)|Kingdom of Stormwind]] (via [[Duskwood]]) from the east to the [[Swamp of Sorrows]] (and, eventually, the [[Dark Portal]] in the [[Blasted Lands]]) from the west. It was, a score of years ago, considered a part of the [[Redridge Mountains]].''[[The Last Guardian]]'', pg. 43 The Ivory Tower of [[Karazhan]], once the dark wizard [[Medivh]]’s seat of power, stands in the center of this jagged region and leaks evil magic into the land. The trees are petrified and leafless, and a terrible wind keens through the canyon. Ogres, demons, undead and a few human gypsies roam the interior. Deadwind Pass connects Duskwood and the Swamp of Sorrows, and travelers are advised to move quickly — whispers tell that a new force has claimed the Ivory Tower, and that the ogres and demons are under its sway. ==Geography== This region is barren and devoid of any useful resources - herbs do not grow here, and there are no precious metals to be found. The only wildlife to speak of are carrion birds. The Redridge Range stretches from the region of the [[Redridge Mountains]] to Deadwind Pass. If merely passing through, the only mobs travelers usually come across are [[vulture]]s, all of which are aggressive and will attack on sight. As one goes further south, they will come across a tribe of [[Deadwind ogres]] living around the bend in the road leading to [[Karazhan]]. Many undead aggressive spirits haunt the remains of the town at the base of Karazhan, far south down the road. Their presence also extends deep underground. There are open cellar entrances in two of the ruined houses which will lead to catacombs and caverns filled with these ghosts. Karazhan can be found in this zone, which is comprised of three instances: the raids [[Lower Karazhan Halls]] and [[Tower of Karazhan]], and the dungeon [[Karazhan Crypt]]. Other than that, there are no battlegrounds here. In addition, there are no travel hubs - players will have to rely on the nearby towns of [[Darkshire]] (Alliance) and [[Stonard]] (Horde) to access this zone. === Maps and subregions === [[File:WorldMap-DeadwindPass.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of the Deadwind Pass.]] WorldMap-DeadwindPass-old.jpg|Deadwind Pass prior to [[patch 1.16.1]]. {{clrl}} {| class="fandom-table" |- || [[Ariden's Camp]] • [[Deadman's Crossing]] • [[Deadwind Ravine]] • [[Karazhan]] • [[Master's Cellar|The Master's Cellar]] • [[Morgan's Plot]] • [[Sleeping Gorge]] • [[The Vice]] ([[Grosh'gok Compound]]) |- |} {{clrl}} ===Dungeons=== {| class="fandom-table" !
